Author: mind
Name: ThrowCrapOut
Description: Compact armoury overview with Sort, Split and Clear actions. Supports English, German, French and Japanese. Open with /tco; settings with /tco config.
Punchline: Organize your armoury and move unused gear to inventory.
Changelog: 0.6.0.1: Added localized action labels, progress colors and a thin progress bar. Pending items are shown in darker colors; active items are light blue. Each move waits for confirmation before the next action delay starts. Confirmation expires after five seconds.
